text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Nwaaa~~~h!! Even Golshi-chan screws up 
sometimes, damn it!!
choice_data_list: It'll definitely go well next time!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Like hell I'm gonna take this lying 
down! Not on my watch!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll win and feed my little 
sister back in the village a mountain of 
delicious white rice!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Nah, not just white rice! Gotta feed 'em 
heaps of tasty pickled radish too!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Trainer! Let's go buy some daikon 
right now and make pickled radish!

Afterward, we bought daikon radish and 
yellowtail at the shopping district, and 
cooked yellowtail radish stew.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: That might be true, but still...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"I got a little sister waitin' for me back 
in the village! I can't go home 
empty-handed...!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—That's it! Let's catch a kappa as a 
souvenir!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Aaaand with that! We're going cucumber 
shopping, Trainer!

Afterward, Gold Ship and I headed to the 
greengrocer in the shopping district, 
bought 10 cucumbers, and ate them with 
salt.
